Ond can now play from more than one place: Navidrome or other OpenSubsonic servers, local music folders, or both at once. Your existing server, library, downloads and favourites carry over when you upgrade.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.6.0-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.6.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13) |
| `Ond-0.6.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.6.0-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11. Still untested on real hardware; issues welcome. |

On Nix: `nix profile install github:Solidsilver/ond/ond-v0.6.0`. [Install instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond#install).

### Sources

- A first run asks where your music is: a server, a folder, or both.
- Settings › Sources lists each server and folder, with its state, and adds or removes them. Removing one deletes only Ond's copy of it, never your music files.
- The switcher at the foot of the sidebar shows one source or all of them. Each source has a colour, and a dot shows where an album, song or queue entry comes from.
- One server going offline doesn't stop the others. Work Offline disconnects servers; folders keep playing.

### Local folders

- Ond reads tags, sort tags, MusicBrainz IDs, ReplayGain, embedded and folder art, and `.lrc` or embedded lyrics.
- Folders are watched; added, changed and moved files show up without a full rescan.
- Stars, ratings and playlists for folder tracks are kept by Ond. Folder music is not scrobbled yet.

### All sources

- The library, search and artist pages cover every source in scope. An artist on two sources is shown once, with their albums grouped by source.
- Filter chips under the library narrow it to some sources. Lists that mix sources get a Source column.
- Adding a song from another source to a server playlist offers to make an Ond playlist instead, leaving the server's playlist unchanged.

### Combined albums

Off by default: Settings › Sources › Combine matching albums.

- The same album on two sources shows as one, with every song from either copy and the formats each copy has.
- Prefer chooses which copy plays: source order or best quality. If that copy's source can't be reached, Ond plays another before skipping.
- Stars and ratings apply to every copy; downloads keep the preferred one.
- Albums are matched by MusicBrainz ID, else by artist and title. Keep apart, in an album's menu, separates a wrong match.

### Upgrading

On first launch Ond moves your library into a folder for its source and renames downloads to say which source they're from. The move is one-way, so don't go back to 0.5.0 afterwards.
